title: How long should a mesh-belt furnace be for 300 kg of screws per hour?
summary: A series of Suneng screw mesh-belt line proposals changes the target from 500 kg/h to 300 kg/h and revises loading and residence conditions for each size. In the second round, calculations using a 900 mm belt and 9 m effective heated length still put the longer sizes below 300 kg/h. Equipment selection should therefore use the actual product mix, rather than applying nominal output to every screw.
